{{Quote|I got bottle of urrqal. You want to have party?|Guta-Nay offers Tur-Mukan urrqal while chasing her|<ref name="RC:HC" />}}
'''Urrqal''' was a strong [[Alcohol/Legends|alcoholic]] beverage made on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Qiilura/Legends|Qiilura]]. The drink was popular on Qiilura during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] forces station there sometimes used it to bribe the poor local population into aiding them or giving up information. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Guta-Nay]] became intoxicated while drinking Urrqal and attempted to chase down [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Etain Tur-Mukan]], offering her some as he tried to catch her.

==Behind the scenes==
Urrqal first appeared in ''[[Republic Commando: Hard Contact]]'' a novel written by [[Karen Traviss]] and released in [[2004]].
